overview.description: The Leverage Shares 1X Short Sk Hynix Daily ETF (SKHZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide inverse (-100%) exposure to the daily price movement of the ADR of SK Hynix Inc., less fees and expenses. SK Hynix Inc SKHZ was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.

data.title: Themes ETFs Goes Live on SK Hynix as One of AI's Marquee IPOs Hits the Tape
data.text: Newly launched SKHX and SKHZ hand active traders a timely, cost-efficient way to play SK Hynix from either direction as shares begin changing hands. GREENWICH, Conn.
